required_categories: Qualified mobile robot and manipulation/transport interfaces
Installed guarded optical patterning and UV cure equipment
Recipe-defined preparation tools for PDMS blanket, films, coating and custom PUA
Verified nonempty masks, slide fixtures and coordinate maps
Contained roller/shaker, bead-release and loose-particle removal interfaces
Calibrated microscopy, high-speed imaging, mechanics, photo-DSC and SEM/EDS
Qualified contained stability fixtures and environmental chamber
Immutable acquisition store and reviewed analysis services
not_supplied: Material preparation recipes not present in the paper
policy: Missing assets are explicit local gates; the paper program is still represented without fabricating those assets.
